body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Casio(www.casio.com) introduced full HD digital camera 'EX-ZR100' at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA for 4 days from January 6.
EX-ZR100 featurs 12.1 mega pixels, 3-inch display and maximum 12.5x Zoom(Wide 24mm).
